universal_primary_grounding.decision: Do not impose universal primary provenance as a core pems/2 semantic invariant at this stage.
universal_primary_grounding.rationale: The accepted full-corpus migration demonstrates semantics-preserving pems/2 representation without manufacturing typed provenance. Requiring universal primary grounding in the core contract would either invalidate preserved legacy semantics or force invented evidence roles. Grounding strength belongs in scoped admission/conformance profiles unless later evidence demonstrates a true universal invariant.
universal_primary_grounding.next_design_requirement: Draft explicit scoped grounding/admission profiles and negative fixtures identifying which proposition/admission classes require primary provenance, which may remain untyped, and how unresolved provenance blocks admission without changing proposition semantics.

canonical_serialization_and_cutover.decision: Remain separately gated; authorize design and proof only, not adoption or cutover.
canonical_serialization_and_cutover.rationale: The migration proves semantic readiness but does not establish a canonical byte representation, codec-version policy, rollback procedure, or authority transition. cove/1 must not be assumed to encode pems/2 canonically merely because the semantic migration is green.
canonical_serialization_and_cutover.next_design_requirement: Evaluate whether cove/1 can losslessly and deterministically encode the accepted pems/2 model without changing the frozen cove/1 contract. If not, draft a versioned successor codec contract such as cove/2. Define deterministic byte generation/round-trip evidence, compatibility/dual-read behavior, exact cutover and rollback procedure, canonical artifact identities, and owner-facing adoption criteria. jcs/1 remains unchanged unless evidence demonstrates a separate byte-contract requirement.

authorized_next_tranche.name: noncanonical_pems2_canonical_adoption_readiness_design
scope: Draft scoped primary-grounding admission/conformance profiles with positive and negative fixtures; do not add a universal core primary requirement without new evidence.
Evaluate canonical serialization options for pems/2, including explicit proof whether frozen cove/1 can or cannot encode pems/2 losslessly without contract reinterpretation.
If cove/1 is insufficient, draft a versioned successor codec contract and deterministic full-corpus encode/decode evidence; do not modify frozen cove/1.
Define canonical byte determinism, human reconstruction, compatibility/dual-read behavior, cutover sequence, rollback sequence, authority-transfer checks, and exact acceptance criteria.
Produce an owner-facing adoption recommendation separating technical readiness from the actual canonical-authority decision.
explicitly_not_authorized: assuming cove/1 is the pems/2 canonical codec without proof
changing jcs/1 without a separately demonstrated need
modifying production code, ADRs, ROADMAP.md, demos, tests, or main

next_owner_gate: Owner approval is required before any future canonical-authority change or pems/2 cutover. The newly authorized tranche is design/evidence only and must return to the Steward before an owner adoption recommendation is made.
governance_outcome: The exact 174-record noncanonical pems/1 -> pems/2 full-corpus migration evidence is accepted. PEMS/2 remains noncanonical. A bounded canonical-adoption-readiness design tranche is authorized; actual canonical adoption/cutover is not authorized.
